title: WIPP 鹽岩層廢棄物隔離先導廠
titleEn: Waste Isolation Pilot Plant (WIPP) Salt Repository
subcategoryTitle: 核安全、除役與後端土木工程
subcategoryTitleEn: Nuclear safety, decommissioning and back-end civil works
summary: 廢棄物隔離先導廠 WIPP 位於新墨西哥州卡爾斯巴德附近地下約 655 m 的二疊紀鹽層中，1999 年起接收美國國防部門產生的超鈾廢棄物；2014 年 2 月因一桶廢棄物內的化學反應造成放射性釋出而停止作業近三年。課程定量分析鹽岩潛變、處置容量、提升機、過濾通風與長期隔離的時間尺度。
summaryEn: The Waste Isolation Pilot Plant lies about 655 m down in Permian salt near Carlsbad, New Mexico, and since 1999 has received transuranic waste from US defence programmes; in February 2014 a chemical reaction in one drum released radioactivity and stopped operations for nearly three years. The course quantifies salt creep, disposal capacity, the hoist, filtered ventilation and the time scale of long-term isolation.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：WIPP 鹽岩層廢棄物隔離先導廠
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Waste Isolation Pilot Plant (WIPP) Salt Repository
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「會自己癒合的鹽岩」與「半衰期與活度衰減」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Salt that heals itself" and "Half-life and decay of activity": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「會自己癒合的鹽岩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Salt that heals itself" is correct?
options: 岩鹽與花崗岩完全不同：它在壓力下會像極濃稠的液體一樣緩慢流動，稱為潛變。
岩石越硬越堅固，才越適合當處置場。
所有放射性廢棄物都要隔離幾十萬年。
optionsEn: Rock salt is nothing like granite: under pressure it flows slowly like a very stiff liquid, a behaviour called creep.
The harder and stronger a rock, the better it suits a repository.
All radioactive waste must be isolated for hundreds of thousands of years.
quiz.explanation: 岩鹽與花崗岩完全不同：它在壓力下會像極濃稠的液體一樣緩慢流動，稱為潛變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rock salt is nothing like granite: under pressure it flows slowly like a very stiff liquid, a behaviour called creep. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 會自己癒合的鹽岩：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Salt that heals itself: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「會自己癒合的鹽岩」如何決定「WIPP 鹽岩層廢棄物隔離先導廠」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Salt that heals itself” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Waste Isolation Pilot Plant (WIPP) Salt Repository”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 岩鹽與花崗岩完全不同：它在壓力下會像極濃稠的液體一樣緩慢流動，稱為潛變。在鹽層中開挖的坑道，四壁與頂底板每年會向內移動幾公分，幾十年後就把放在裡面的廢棄物包緊，裂隙也會自行閉合。鹽層能在同一個地方存在兩億多年，本身就證明這段時間沒有流動的地下水通過——否則鹽早就溶掉了。這兩點使鹽岩成為處置場的理想母岩，但也表示運轉期間必須不斷維護坑道。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rock salt is nothing like granite: under pressure it flows slowly like a very stiff liquid, a behaviour called creep. Walls, roof and floor of a room mined in salt move inward a few centimetres a year, wrap tightly round the waste within decades, and fractures close of themselves. That a salt bed has stayed in place over two hundred million years is itself proof no flowing groundwater passed in that time, or the salt would have dissolved. Both points make salt an ideal host rock, but also mean rooms need constant upkeep while operating. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：處置層位於地下約 655 m 的鹽層，鹽層年齡約 2.5 億年
steps.observationEn: Project file: The disposal horizon is about 655 m down in salt about 250 million years old
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩石越硬越堅固，才越適合當處置場。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The harder and stronger a rock, the better it suits a repository." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「會自己癒合的鹽岩」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Salt that heals itself”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Rock salt is nothing like granite: under pressure it flows slowly like a very stiff liquid, a behaviour called creep. quiz.question: 依「會自己癒合的鹽岩」的模型 t = h / r，高 4 m 的處置室以每年 5 cm 的速率閉合所需的時間（速率為代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model t = h / r for "Salt that heals itself", which value is closest to the time for a 4 m high room to close at 5 cm a year (representative rate)?
optionsEn: 40.0 years
80 years
800 years
quiz.explanation: t = h / r；代入 h = 4 m、r = 5 cm/a，得 80 年（高 4 m 的處置室以每年 5 cm 的速率閉合所需的時間（速率為代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: t = h / r; with h = 4 m, r = 5 cm/a the result is 80 years (time for a 4 m high room to close at 5 cm a year (representative rate)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 會自己癒合的鹽岩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Salt that heals itself: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「會自己癒合的鹽岩」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Salt that heals itself” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = h / r；代入 h = 4 m、r = 5 cm/a，得 80 年（高 4 m 的處置室以每年 5 cm 的速率閉合所需的時間（速率為代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 r 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = h / r; with h = 4 m, r = 5 cm/a the result is 80 years (time for a 4 m high room to close at 5 cm a year (representative rate)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise r by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：r 增加 10% 時，結果變為 73 年（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising r by 10% changes the result to 73 years (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 80 年（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 r 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 80 years (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in r with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t = h / r；代入 h = 4 m、r = 5 cm/a，得 80 年（高 4 m 的處置室以每年 5 cm 的速率閉合所需的時間（速率為代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: t = h / r; with h = 4 m, r = 5 cm/a the result is 80 years (time for a 4 m high room to close at 5 cm a year (representative rate)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: r 增加 10% 時，結果變為 73 年（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising r by 10% changes the result to 73 years (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「會自己癒合的鹽岩」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Salt that heals itself"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
豎井提升只是把東西放下去，沒有什麼技術。
以收斂計與伸縮儀長期量測每個處置室的閉合速率，並定期檢查頂板的岩栓與離層情形。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Shaft hoisting is just lowering things and takes no skill.
Convergence meters and extensometers measure closure rate of every room over years, and roof bolts and bed separation are inspected regularly.
quiz.explanation: 以收斂計與伸縮儀長期量測每個處置室的閉合速率，並定期檢查頂板的岩栓與離層情形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Convergence meters and extensometers measure closure rate of every room over years, and roof bolts and bed separation are inspected regularly. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 會自己癒合的鹽岩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Salt that heals itself: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「會自己癒合的鹽岩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Salt that heals itself” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以收斂計與伸縮儀長期量測每個處置室的閉合速率，並定期檢查頂板的岩栓與離層情形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convergence meters and extensometers measure closure rate of every room over years, and roof bolts and bed separation are inspected regularly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鹽岩處置場要依潛變速率安排開挖與處置的時程，開挖後盡快處置並封閉。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Schedule excavation and emplacement in a salt repository by creep rate, emplacing and closing soon after mining.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：頂板的鹽層沿黏土夾層離層後可能整片塌落；事故停工期間無法進行維護，部分區域因此被永久放棄。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Roof salt separating along clay seams may fall in slabs, and with maintenance impossible during the accident shutdown some areas were abandoned for good. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Convergence meters and extensometers measure closure rate of every room over years, and roof bolts and bed separation are inspected regularly.

quiz.questionEn: When "Salt that heals itself" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

steps.title: 會自己癒合的鹽岩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Salt that heals itself: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「會自己癒合的鹽岩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Salt that heals itself” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 頂板的鹽層沿黏土夾層離層後可能整片塌落；事故停工期間無法進行維護，部分區域因此被永久放棄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「WIPP 鹽岩層廢棄物隔離先導廠」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Roof salt separating along clay seams may fall in slabs, and with maintenance impossible during the accident shutdown some areas were abandoned for good. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Waste Isolation Pilot Plant (WIPP) Salt Repository”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這兩點使鹽岩成為處置場的理想母岩，但也表示運轉期間必須不斷維護坑道。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Both points make salt an ideal host rock, but also mean rooms need constant upkeep while operating.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩石越硬越堅固，才越適合當處置場。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The harder and stronger a rock, the better it suits a repository." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

options: 所有放射性廢棄物都要隔離幾十萬年。
處置場挖好之後，想放多少就可以放多少。
放射性核種的活度隨時間呈指數下降，每經過一個半衰期剩下一半。

Once a repository is dug, as much can be placed as anyone likes.
The activity of a radionuclide falls exponentially, halving with each half-life.
quiz.explanation: 放射性核種的活度隨時間呈指數下降，每經過一個半衰期剩下一半。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 半衰期與活度衰減：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Half-life and decay of activity: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「半衰期與活度衰減」如何決定「WIPP 鹽岩層廢棄物隔離先導廠」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Half-life and decay of activity” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Waste Isolation Pilot Plant (WIPP) Salt Repository”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 放射性核種的活度隨時間呈指數下降，每經過一個半衰期剩下一半。廢棄物的危害期長短取決於其中主要核種的半衰期：銫-137 與鍶-90 約三十年，經過三百年（十個半衰期）只剩約千分之一，這是低放射性廢棄物處置設施以數百年作為監管期的依據；長半衰期核種則需要深層地質處置把隔離時間拉長到數萬年以上。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The activity of a radionuclide falls exponentially, halving with each half-life. How long waste remains hazardous depends on the half-lives of its main nuclides: caesium-137 and strontium-90 are about thirty years, leaving about one thousandth after three hundred years or ten half-lives, the basis for institutional control of a few centuries at low-level waste facilities; long-lived nuclides require deep geological disposal to extend isolation beyond tens of thousands of years. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

How long waste remains hazardous depends on the half-lives of its main nuclides: caesium-137 and strontium-90 are about thirty years, leaving about one thousandth after three hundred years or ten half-lives, the basis for institutional control of a few centuries at low-level waste facilities; long-lived nuclides require deep geological disposal to extend isolation beyond tens of thousands of years.

quiz.question: 依「半衰期與活度衰減」的模型 A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½)，經過 t 年後剩餘的活度比例最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½) for "Half-life and decay of activity", which value is closest to the fraction of activity remaining after t years?
quiz.explanation: A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½)；代入 ty = 10000 a、Thalf = 24100 a，得 75.005 %（經過 t 年後剩餘的活度比例）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½); with ty = 10000 a, Thalf = 24100 a the result is 75.005 % (fraction of activity remaining after t years). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 半衰期與活度衰減：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Half-life and decay of activity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「半衰期與活度衰減」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Half-life and decay of activity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½)；代入 ty = 10000 a、Thalf = 24100 a，得 75.005 %（經過 t 年後剩餘的活度比例）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 ty 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½); with ty = 10000 a, Thalf = 24100 a the result is 75.005 % (fraction of activity remaining after t years). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise ty by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：ty 增加 10% 時，結果變為 72.879 %（-2.8%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising ty by 10% changes the result to 72.879 % (-2.8%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 75.005 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 ty 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 75.005 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in ty with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½)；代入 ty = 10000 a、Thalf = 24100 a，得 75.005 %（經過 t 年後剩餘的活度比例）。
knowledge.textEn: A/A₀ = 0.5^(t/T½); with ty = 10000 a, Thalf = 24100 a the result is 75.005 % (fraction of activity remaining after t years).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: ty 增加 10% 時，結果變為 72.879 %（-2.8%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising ty by 10% changes the result to 72.879 % (-2.8%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「半衰期與活度衰減」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Half-life and decay of activity"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以加馬能譜分析鑑別廢棄物中的核種與活度，並用比例因子法推估難測核種；處置前的活度清單須與設施的接收準則逐項比對。
只要每個人都不超過法定劑量限值，就不需要再做任何最佳化。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.

Identify nuclides and activities in waste by gamma spectrometry and estimate hard-to-measure nuclides with scaling factors, then compare the inventory item by item with the facility's waste acceptance criteria before disposal.
As long as nobody exceeds the legal dose limit, no further optimisation is needed.
quiz.explanation: 以加馬能譜分析鑑別廢棄物中的核種與活度，並用比例因子法推估難測核種；處置前的活度清單須與設施的接收準則逐項比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Identify nuclides and activities in waste by gamma spectrometry and estimate hard-to-measure nuclides with scaling factors, then compare the inventory item by item with the facility's waste acceptance criteria before disposal. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 半衰期與活度衰減：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Half-life and decay of activity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「半衰期與活度衰減」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Half-life and decay of activity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以加馬能譜分析鑑別廢棄物中的核種與活度，並用比例因子法推估難測核種；處置前的活度清單須與設施的接收準則逐項比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify nuclides and activities in waste by gamma spectrometry and estimate hard-to-measure nuclides with scaling factors, then compare the inventory item by item with the facility's waste acceptance criteria before disposal. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：廢棄物包件的核種清單、量測日期與不確定度要隨包件終身保存，處置場的總量控制以長半衰期核種為準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Nuclide inventory, measurement date and uncertainty must stay with each package for life, and repository totals should be controlled on long-lived nuclides.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若活度清單漏列長半衰期核種（如碳-14、鎳-63 或錒系元素），依短半衰期核種設計的監管期結束後仍殘留不可忽略的危害。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If long-lived nuclides such as carbon-14, nickel-63 or actinides are missing from the inventory, a non-negligible hazard remains after a control period designed for short-lived nuclides. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「半衰期與活度衰減」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Half-life and decay of activity" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
處置場挖好之後，想放多少就可以放多少。
若活度清單漏列長半衰期核種（如碳-14、鎳-63 或錒系元素），依短半衰期核種設計的監管期結束後仍殘留不可忽略的危害。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Once a repository is dug, as much can be placed as anyone likes.
If long-lived nuclides such as carbon-14, nickel-63 or actinides are missing from the inventory, a non-negligible hazard remains after a control period designed for short-lived nuclides.

quiz.explanationEn: If long-lived nuclides such as carbon-14, nickel-63 or actinides are missing from the inventory, a non-negligible hazard remains after a control period designed for short-lived nuclides. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 半衰期與活度衰減：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Half-life and decay of activity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「半衰期與活度衰減」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Half-life and decay of activity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若活度清單漏列長半衰期核種（如碳-14、鎳-63 或錒系元素），依短半衰期核種設計的監管期結束後仍殘留不可忽略的危害。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「WIPP 鹽岩層廢棄物隔離先導廠」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: If long-lived nuclides such as carbon-14, nickel-63 or actinides are missing from the inventory, a non-negligible hazard remains after a control period designed for short-lived nuclides. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Waste Isolation Pilot Plant (WIPP) Salt Repository”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：廢棄物的危害期長短取決於其中主要核種的半衰期：銫-137 與鍶-90 約三十年，經過三百年（十個半衰期）只剩約千分之一，這是低放射性廢棄物處置設施以數百年作為監管期的依據；長半衰期核種則需要深層地質處置把隔離時間拉長到數萬年以上。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: How long waste remains hazardous depends on the half-lives of its main nuclides: caesium-137 and strontium-90 are about thirty years, leaving about one thousandth after three hundred years or ten half-lives, the basis for institutional control of a few centuries at low-level waste facilities; long-lived nuclides require deep geological disposal to extend isolation beyond tens of thousands of years.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有放射性廢棄物都要隔離幾十萬年。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All radioactive waste must be isolated for hundreds of thousands of years." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若活度清單漏列長半衰期核種（如碳-14、鎳-63 或錒系元素），依短半衰期核種設計的監管期結束後仍殘留不可忽略的危害。
knowledge.textEn: If long-lived nuclides such as carbon-14, nickel-63 or actinides are missing from the inventory, a non-negligible hazard remains after a control period designed for short-lived nuclides.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
